metadata.title: Secure‑Resilience IoT / Low‑Assurance SSPP
metadata.remarks: System Security and Privacy Plan specializing Secure‑Resilience for IoT and low‑assurance devices where trust, updateability, and state reversibility are limited or opaque.

import-profile.remarks: This SSPP inherits Secure‑Resilience Platform rules and applies conservative constraints appropriate for low‑assurance IoT environments.

system-characteristics.system-description: IoT and low‑assurance environments include commodity, consumer‑grade, vendor‑managed, externally connected, or constrained devices. This SSPP emphasizes isolation, suppression, and replacement over restore or resume, due to limited assurance of integrity and lifecycle control.

props.name: domain
props.remarks: Applies to IoT and externally managed devices with limited controls.

props.name: trust-assumption
props.remarks: IoT devices are assumed minimally trusted by default.

props.name: state-assumption
props.remarks: Device state is often opaque or partially irreversible.

props.name: preferred-resilience-outcome
props.remarks: Isolation or replacement is preferred over restore or resume.

props.name: implicit-restore
props.remarks: Backup restore or firmware rollback must not occur automatically.

props.name: implicit-resume
props.remarks: No IoT device may resume operation without explicit eligibility.

props.name: update-expectation
props.remarks: Updates may be unavailable, delayed, or vendor‑controlled.

props.name: replacement-bias
props.remarks: Replace devices when trust degrades rather than attempt deep remediation.

system-implementation.remarks: IoT resilience is implemented through strict Secure‑Resilience gating, aggressive isolation, and rapid decommissioning or replacement. Restore and resume are exceptional and require explicit eligibility.

components.title: Backup and Recovery
components.remarks: Backups, if any, are primarily for evidence and configuration reference; restore is rare.

components.title: Disaster Recovery
components.remarks: DR generally applies to backend services, not IoT endpoints.

components.title: Continuity of Operations
components.remarks: Continuity favors isolation, reduced functionality, or replacement.

roles.title: IoT / Low‑Assurance Resilience Architecture
roles.remarks: Defines conservative resilience constraints and replacement criteria.

roles.title: IoT Resilience Governance
roles.remarks: Approves risk tolerance, isolation thresholds, and replacement decisions.

roles.title: IoT Resilience Operations
roles.remarks: Executes isolation, decommissioning, and replacement actions.

roles.title: IoT Resilience Monitoring
roles.remarks: Monitors device behavior, trust degradation, and unsafe recovery attempts.

control-implementation.remarks: IoT resilience relies on Secure‑Resilience constraints applied to NIST SP 800‑53 CP controls and conservative operational principles. This SSPP introduces no additional control requirements.
